Left joins all Montgomery census tracts to the pre-aggregated pharmacy counts per tract (grp='all'), then filters for tracts where the total pharmacy count is zero, ensuring zero-count tracts are included via the LEFT JOIN and COALESCE. Results are sorted alphabetically by tract name and limited to 200 rows.
sql:
SELECT t.name AS tract_name, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS pharmacy_count, t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid AND c.run_id = 'r_20261026_c08226' AND c.source = 'm1_city' AND c.grp = 'all'
WHERE COALESCE(c.n, 0) = 0
ORDER BY t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
